PeacockDB benchmark results — every device tree side by side, one row per query and mode. Times are device-side, in ms: the total is load plus execute. The peak is the accountant's peak, a lower bound on device memory, in GiB. A load marked unpinned was read without the pinned host cache: its section's pinned_cache is off, or the section predates the cache.

DuckDB's time is one DuckDB CLI process's wall time: the process started, the database opened and the query run, over warm native storage, the second-smallest of its runs, in ms. The floor is SELECT 1 timed the same way, what each time holds besides its query: duckdb-cpu128, tpcds sf40: DuckDB 1.5.4, 128 threads, host computeinstance-e01t2mm4265y8x88ey, floor 36 ms; duckdb-cpu128, tpch sf40: DuckDB 1.5.4, 128 threads, host computeinstance-e01t2mm4265y8x88ey, floor 30 ms.
